title: Temperature (and chemical potential, price, rate-distortion multiplier, regularizer) as the shadow price of a maintenance budget: a cross-layer reorganization of Jaynes + convex duality
scientific_domain: Thermodynamics / equilibrium statistical mechanics / information physics (MaxEnt-MaxCal, rate-distortion, convex duality)

card.one_sentence_claim: SBT reorganizes the Jaynes/convex-duality fact that inverse temperature is the Lagrange multiplier of a mean-energy constraint into a cross-layer 'currency-constraint principle': because a packaged macro-object persists only under bounded lower-layer spending (E[u|Y]<=b, via P5 packaging + P6 accounting), a single-constraint MaxCal closure q~exp(-lambda u) makes its native higher-layer currency the shadow price lambda=dPhi*/db (=0 exactly on slack, positive when binding), exhibiting temperature, chemical potential, market price, the rate-distortion multiplier and the regularization strength as the same dual-of-a-budget object on different substrates.
card.target_known_fact: In equilibrium statistical mechanics the inverse temperature beta is the Lagrange multiplier of the mean-energy constraint in the Jaynes MaxEnt derivation of the Gibbs canonical ensemble p_i = exp(-beta E_i)/Z, obeying complementary slackness (multiplier zero when constraint inactive, positive when it binds); the identical dual-coordinate role is played by chemical potential, market price (Arrow-Debreu), the rate-distortion multiplier (Berger 1971; Cover-Thomas) and learning-rate/regularization strength -- all instances of a Lagrange dual variable in a constrained convex program (Boyd-Vandenberghe).

theory_basis.component: Currency-constraint principle: lower-layer currency u_l becomes higher-layer budget E[u_l|Y]<=b because a packaged object persists only under bounded lower-layer spending; higher-layer currency emerges as shadow price lambda=dPhi*/db, =0 exactly on slack. Load-bearing novel structural law (the maintenance-economics 'why' standard duality lacks).

Single-constraint MaxCal / conditional-logit closure q(lambda)_ij ~ exp(-lambda u_ij)/Z; for target budget b solve E_q[u]=b for lambda by 1D root-finding; data-driven recovery via McFadden conditional-logit likelihood. The computation that returns the multiplier; exactly the Gibbs-form recovery.

P5 packaging endomap E_{tau,f}(mu)=U_f Q_f(mu P^tau) and P6 audit (path-reversal KL Sigma_T / Schnakenberg cycle affinities a_ij=log(P_ij/P_ji)) supplying the lower-layer maintenance currency; cycle rank beta_1=m-n+c bounds independent currency directions.
Deterministic-pushforward finite-KL monotonicity, Lean4/mathlib (CurrencyMorphism.finiteKL_map_le): coarse deterministic observation cannot increase the finite-KL audit.
Discrete max-entropy (Maxwellian-like) local-equilibrium completion as canonical lift U_f in discrete BGK: f_eq is the unique exponential-family distribution matching retained moments.
theory_basis.role: second substrate -- but produces a COMPLETION U_f, NOT a shadow price lambda=dPhi*/db

card.minimum_viable_result: A single finite-Markov demonstration (already executed and frozen in To_Spend_a_Stone) showing (i) the constrained MaxCal closure q~exp(-lambda u) returns lambda(b) monotone with spearman ~ -1 and lambda=0 exactly on slack, and (ii) this lambda is, by construction, the same shadow-price object as Jaynes's beta -- i.e. an honest REORGANIZATION of the canonical-ensemble multiplier as a maintenance-budget dual, with a measurable complementary-slackness signature. No claim beyond the finite MaxCal laboratory.
card.stronger_result: Prove the persistence-as-budget lemma as a genuine theorem (idempotence-defect bound delta_{tau,f}<=epsilon FORCES a maintenance budget b(epsilon)) AND a normal-form/functorial statement identifying the dual-of-budget object across >=3 independent substrates (stat-mech beta with a reservoir, rate-distortion multiplier, market price) with shared transformation laws -- turning the cross-domain 'sameness' from informal analogy into a derived classification.
card.fallback_result: A high-compression REINTERPRETATION: SBT exhibits temperature, chemical potential, price, rate-distortion lambda and regularization strength as instances of one MaxCal/convex-duality dual-of-a-budget object, with a finite-Markov demonstration of the complementary-slackness (lambda=0-on-slack) signature, explicitly framed as recovery/reorganization of Jaynes + convex duality, not a derivation of temperature.

Cost matrix u_ij (load-bearing; permutation degrades held-out NLL)
Exponential MaxCal/Gibbs closure ansatz q~exp(-lambda u) (= Jaynes form by hand)
Choice of Phi=entropy as higher-layer potential
Which audit proxy (Sigma_T/EPR/cycle affinity) is declared the maintenance currency
Which second substrate is exhibited for cross-domain sameness

opposite_world_test.explanation: Two-part. The headline complementary-slackness signature (monotone lambda(b), lambda=0 on slack, spearman ~ -1) is NOT opposite-world-flexible: it is a forced consequence of convex duality once the exp(-lambda u) ansatz is adopted (g'=-Var_q(u)<0), so it carries near-zero predictive risk -- guaranteed, not retrodicted. The genuinely novel content (persistence-as-budget 'why', cross-substrate 'same object') IS flexible: line 222 'such as' is asserted, and the idempotence experiment uses a hand-built budget-reweighted kernel; the informal cross-domain sameness (no functor; explicit no-universal-cost-unit disclaimer) could absorb almost any second substrate. The falsifiable-looking part is risk-free; the contingent part is unconstrained -- the ad-hoc signature.

audit.audit_verdict: HIGH FLEXIBILITY / RECOVERY-NOT-DERIVATION, honestly self-labeled (class C). Headline target fully IMPORTED (Jaynes->Gibbs + Boyd-Vandenberghe; Boltzmann form 'put in by hand'; paper concedes duality 'begins too late', line 113). Monotone-price/slack signature is an analytic CONSEQUENCE of the chosen ansatz, not a risked prediction. ~10 adjustable structural choices vs ~2 independent matched qualitative facts; remaining frozen numerics are internal toy regression certificates. Two novel pieces weak: persistence-as-budget asserted ('such as', line 222), not proved; cross-substrate 'one object' informal (BGK produces a lift U_f, not a lambda=dPhi*/db). Lean certifies ONLY deterministic-pushforward finite-KL monotonicity. Sigma_T/EPR are informational proxies (audit-proxy temperature, no reservoir). Defensible only as the explicitly-scoped recovery fallback.

skeptic_panel.consensus: All four skeptics: is_actually_new=false, beats_baseline=false, adversarial_survival_score=2, no fatal objections. Convergent serious objections: (1) headline content imported wholesale (Jaynes MaxEnt + Boyd-Vandenberghe), target used to design theory; (2) the single novel step (persistence-as-budget) is asserted with a hedge ('such as', To_Spend line 222), not proved as delta_{tau,f}<=eps => E[u|Y]<=b(eps); (3) the 'falsifiable' monotone-price/slack signature is mathematically forced by the chosen exp(-lambda u) ansatz (g'=-Var_q(u)<0), hence guaranteed not risked; (4) cross-substrate 'same object' is informal analogy with explicit no-universal-cost-unit disclaimer -- and skeptic #2 verified the BGK second substrate yields a COMPLETION U_f, not a dual variable lambda, so it does not even instantiate the claim; (5) Sigma_T/EPR are informational/audit proxies, not physical entropy production -- audit-proxy temperature, no reservoir; (6) DoF (~10) >> independently-constrained facts (~2).
missing_derivations: Proved persistence-as-budget theorem: delta_{tau,f}<=epsilon => E[u_l|Y]<=b(epsilon) with explicit b(epsilon).
Explicit shadow-price/dual computation on a SECOND substrate (BGK or other) producing an actual lambda=dPhi*/db, not merely a completion U_f, with a shared transformation law.
A functor/normal-form theorem identifying temperature, rate-distortion multiplier and market price as one object.
Derivation of the exp(-lambda u) closure form from SBT substrate dynamics (currently imported as Jaynes ansatz).
A thermodynamic bridge from the Sigma_T/EPR audit proxy to physical entropy production, or dropping the 'temperature' framing.
Lean coverage of the duality, slack law or objecthood-as-budget (currently only finiteKL_map_le, the audit side).
minimum_acceptance_conditions: Present strictly as RECOVERY/REORGANIZATION of Jaynes + convex duality in a finite Markov MaxCal laboratory; no derivation of temperature or beta.
State that the monotone-price/exact-slack signature is an analytic consequence of the chosen ansatz (guaranteed, not a risked prediction).
Demote 'derives' (candidates.json core_claim) to 'recovers/reorganizes' to match the paper's 'such as' status and class C.
Flag the persistence-as-budget step as an asserted modeling postulate, not a theorem, until the delta=>b(delta) lemma exists.
Downgrade cross-substrate 'one object' to explicitly informal analogy ('same kind in form, not in substance', line 422); do not present BGK as an independent corroboration of a shared dual variable.
Keep Sigma_T/EPR as informational/audit proxies (audit-proxy temperature, no reservoir); confine Lean claim to finiteKL_map_le.

repair.revised_one_sentence_claim: In a finite Markov MaxCal laboratory, SBT RECOVERS (does not derive) the Jaynes/convex-duality fact that a constraint multiplier is a shadow price lambda=dPhi*/db with complementary slackness, and REORGANIZES it as a cross-layer 'currency-constraint' vocabulary in which a packaged object's lower-layer maintenance spend is POSITED (asserted, not proved) to be bounded, E[u_l|Y]<=b, so that on the chosen MaxCal closure q~exp(-lambda u) the higher-layer currency lambda is the dual of that posited budget; the resulting monotone-price-with-exact-zero-slack signature (spearman ~ -0.99923, n_tail_zero_lambda=5) is an analytic consequence of the chosen exponential ansatz (since g'(lambda)=-Var_q(u)<0), not a risked prediction, and the identification of temperature/chemical-potential/price/rate-distortion-multiplier/regularizer as 'the same kind of object in form' is an explicitly informal cross-domain analogy, not a derived classification.
repair.new_minimum_viable_result: A reproducible finite-Markov shadow-price laboratory presenting the frozen budget-sweep/slack/proxy-ablation/ladder/idempotence experiments as ONE complementary-slackness demonstration table, with three honesty annotations carried inline: (a) the slack/monotonicity signature is labeled an analytic consequence of the exp(-lambda u) ansatz (guaranteed); (b) the persistence-as-budget step is labeled an asserted modeling postulate (the 'such as' form of line 222), not the proved implication delta_{tau,f}<=eps => E[u|Y]<=b(eps); (c) the cross-substrate sameness is labeled informal analogy, and the BGK example is correctly described as a COMPLETION/lift U_f (an exp-family matching moments), NOT a computed shadow price lambda. Net deliverable: an honest, high-compression reorganization of Jaynes + convex duality with a measurable-but-guaranteed slack signature.

remaining_objections: FATAL-ADJACENT (non-fatal, but caps the score): the entire headline predictive content on the temperature target is imported (Jaynes MaxEnt + Boyd-Vandenberghe). Repair cannot manufacture a derivation; this is a recovery by the card's and paper's own admission (class C).

The load-bearing novel step (persistence-as-budget) remains ASSERTED, not proved; no allowed repair can supply the missing theorem delta_{tau,f}<=eps => E[u|Y]<=b(eps) without forbidden new assumptions. The 'maintenance-economics why' therefore remains a vocabulary, not machinery.
The advertised falsifiable signature remains analytically FORCED by the chosen ansatz, so it provides no independent confirmation of any SBT-specific claim even after honest relabeling.

Cross-substrate 'one object' remains informal analogy; the second substrate (BGK) produces a completion U_f, not a dual variable, so it does not instantiate the unification. No functor/normal-form exists; the no-universal-cross-domain-cost-unit disclaimer stands.

The idempotence-buys-objecthood result uses a hand-built budget-reweighted kernel W=P_base*exp(-lambda u), so the monotone defect drop is engineered, not an independent confirmation that maintenance budgets produce objecthood.
DoF (~10 structural choices, including the load-bearing cost matrix u_ij) >> independently-constrained facts (~2).

score_rationale.impact: 2 -- If the persistence-as-budget step were a theorem it would be a genuine unifying contribution; as a recovery + asserted vocabulary it offers conceptual compression valued mainly within the SBT program and as pedagogy, not a result physicists will build on.
score_rationale.execution_ease: 4 -- The minimum-viable result is already executed and frozen (public six-birds-currency repo); reproduction is days. The stronger result (lemma + functor) is weeks-to-months and partly disclaimed, but the repaired deliverable is low cost.
score_rationale.plausibility: 4 -- The recovered content is literally textbook-true (Jaynes + Boyd-Vandenberghe), so the honest claim is highly plausible; the only implausible part (the unproved cross-layer 'why' as derived) has been demoted.
score_rationale.non_ad_hocness: 2 -- ~10 adjustable structural choices vs ~2 matched facts; cost matrix and lens are load-bearing and chosen after knowing the target; the contingent novel piece is asserted, the risk-free piece is imported. Capped low.
score_rationale.discriminative_power: 1 -- The headline signature is analytically forced by the chosen ansatz (g'=-Var_q(u)<0); it cannot come out otherwise, so it discriminates nothing. Opposite-world flexible on the novel content. Near-zero independent predictive content.
score_rationale.audience_legibility: 4 -- Very clear to the target audiences (MaxEnt/MaxCal, rate-distortion, convex-duality, ML-regularization communities); frozen numerics, Lean-anchored audit inequality, and an honest recovery-vs-reorganization framing make it easy to read and evaluate.
score_rationale.precision: 2 -- Crosses the no-micro-thermodynamic-interface disclaimer if read as physical temperature (capped); the only sharp quantitative outputs (spearman, n_tail_zero_lambda) are guaranteed by construction, and the load-bearing budget step is hedged ('such as'), so genuine predictive precision is low.
score_rationale.robustness: 3 -- The frozen numerics are reproducible and stable (5-seed, deterministic), and a proxy permutation degrades them in the expected direction; but robustness is robustness of an engineered toy regression, not of an empirical or derived claim.
score_rationale.baseline_advantage: 1 -- Explicitly RECOVERY-not-improvement: matches the standard Jaynes + convex-duality account with no new value of beta, no new bound, no from-microdynamics derivation; the paper itself concedes it 'begins too late' and 'does not out-predict' the baseline. Capped at 1.
score_rationale.publication_potential: 2 -- Publishable as a clean conceptual/expository note or workshop piece in the MaxCal/closure-emergence niche if scoped honestly as reorganization; not publishable as a new physics result. Upgrades to ~4 only if the persistence-as-budget lemma and a genuine functor are proved.
